startingDeck.vowels: A, I, U, E, O (2 each, 10 tiles)

?.name: Wildcard
?.rule: Becomes the letter that makes a valid word with the highest Spell Power. Scores 0. Cannot be upgraded.

!.name: Exclamation
!.rule: Only at the end of a word or after a single letter. Cannot be cast alone. Consecutive ! add 2,4,6,10,16,26,42 Spell Power (FIB x2, cumulative). Counts toward crit length.

,.name: Comma
,.rule: Between two words to cast both at once; both must be valid. Not counted toward crit length.

red.name: Red Paint · Might
red.d: +1 Might when played (+1 Spell Power to attack weapons this combat).

blue.name: Blue Paint · Robust
blue.d: +1 Robust when played (+1 Spell Power to defense weapons this combat).

green.name: Green Paint · Agility
green.d: Draws +1 tile when the word is submitted.

gold.name: Gold Paint · Fortune
gold.d: +1 Gold each time it is played.

slimy.name: Slimy
slimy.d: Spell Power is 0 for its first use.

lock.name: Locked
lock.d: Cannot be played for N turns.

condemn.name: Condemned
condemn.d: Banished for the rest of this combat if still unplayed in hand at end of turn. It returns to your deck after the fight.

fragile: Fragile tiles are banished for the rest of the combat after one use (created by Utility Belt, Rune Chisel, Jester's Brew, Battle Cry).
